name: zhiban-yinling-system
description: 智伴银龄：具身智能生活陪伴系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/adapters
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w apps/mcp-server
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/adapters
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w apps/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/adapters && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.verify: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps && npm run build:apps && npm run test
